new_applications.source: Barlet, Some examples due to H. Hironaka, arXiv1501.01129v2, section2
new_applications.exact_application: The reduced image ideal of the proper analytic center is coherent and has no interior on the smooth irreducible target. The graph closure in the finite projective generator bundle is analytic, proper and bimeromorphic. Over the generic smooth center, the explicit least-order ratio chart is smooth. The main reduced component of the source-target fiber product is analytic and proper and contains the existing smooth generic lift. These hypotheses are applied at every extraction step; no compact graph closure is inferred for an arbitrary transcendental map. Section2 includes its generator graph construction and the complete strict-fiber-product discussion. This use does not require the later Hironaka deformation examples.

new_applications.exact_application: The whole current Proposition3.1.12 proof is read: the decreasing ordinary models in the closed big a*kappa background have positive mass from the smaller-background competitor, so its positive-mass divisorial conclusion applies to each divisor individually. Proposition3.2.1 and its whole printed proof identify ideal classes on the compact Kahler base at every real weight. Proposition3.2.10 and its whole proof identify finite analytic ordinary/ideal envelopes with the original analytic type. Theorem1.6.2 retains the exact dyadic ideal type and quasi-equisingular approximation hypotheses; it refers the proof to Demailly/DPS, whose exact earlier application records remain separately assessed, not recursively certified by reading this statement. AppendixB.1.1 and its complete printed proof realize arbitrary prime divisors, with Hironaka Chow lemma and smooth resolution as explicitly imported foundations. Only the bibliographic date differs from the frozen July18 author source. Old source bytes, frozen article and both native inputs are unchanged.
